questions.text:
Production of iron in blast furnace follows the following equation
$\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}(\mathrm{~s})+4 \mathrm{CO}(\mathrm{g}) \rightarrow 3 \mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{l})+4 \mathrm{CO}_{2}(\mathrm{~g})$
when 4.640 kg of $\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}$ and 2.520 kg of CO are allowed to react then the amount of iron (in g ) produced is :
[Given : Molar Atomic mass $\left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right): \mathrm{Fe}=56$
Molar Atomic mass $\left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right): 0=16$
Molar Atomic mass $\left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right):=\mathrm{C}=12$

options.D:
4200

Official Ans. by NTA (C)
Ans. (C)
Sol. Moles of $\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}=\frac{4.640 \times 10^{3}}{232}=20$
Moles of $\mathrm{CO}=\frac{2.52 \times 10^{3}}{28}=90$
So limiting Reagent $=\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}$
So moles of Fe formed = 60
Weight of $\mathrm{Fe}=60 \times 56=3360 \mathrm{gms}$

steps:
Moles of $\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}=\frac{4.640 \times 10^{3}}{232}=20$
Moles of $\mathrm{CO}=\frac{2.52 \times 10^{3}}{28}=90$
So limiting Reagent $=\mathrm{Fe}_{3} \mathrm{O}_{4}$
So moles of Fe formed = 60
Weight of $\mathrm{Fe}=60 \times 56=3360 \mathrm{gms}$

questions.text: Which of the following statements are correct ?

options.A: The electronic configuration of Cr is $[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{1}$.
options.B: The magnetic quantum number may have a negative value.
options.C: In the ground state of an atom, the orbitals are filled in order of their increasing energies.
options.D:
The total number of nodes are given by $\mathrm{n}-2$.

Choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :
(A) (A), (C) and (D) only
(B) (A) and (B) only
(C) (A) and (C) only
(D) (A), (B) and (C) only

Official Ans. by NTA (D)
Ans. (D)

Sol. (A) $\mathrm{Cr}=[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{1}$
(B) $\mathrm{m}=-\ell$ to $+\ell$
(C) According to Aufbau principle, orbitals are filled in order of their increasing energies.
(D) Total nodes $=\mathrm{n}-1$

steps:
(A) $\mathrm{Cr}=[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^{5} 4 \mathrm{~s}^{1}$
(B) $\mathrm{m}=-\ell$ to $+\ell$
(C) According to Aufbau principle, orbitals are filled in order of their increasing energies.
(D) Total nodes $=\mathrm{n}-1$

questions.text: Which one of the following reactions indicates the reducing ability of hydrogen peroxide in basic medium ?

options.D:
$\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2} \rightarrow \mathrm{Mn}^{4+}+2 \mathrm{OH}^{-}$

Official Ans. by NTA (C)
Ans. (C)

Sol. In option (A) and (C) reducing action of hydrogen peroxide is shown.

In option (A) it is in acidic medium, in option (B) it is in basic medium.
or
For reducing ability $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2}$ changes to $\mathrm{O}_{2}$, i.e. oxidize , so in option 'A' \& 'C' $\mathrm{O}_{2}$ is formed but 'A' is in acidic medium so option - C correct.
